comparison.objective: Free a fused print-in-place hinge by repeated rocking without snapping it, then swing it beyond 120°. Candidate tunes a shock absorber and locks its selected setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires alternating sub-failure rocking cycles and force restraint until programmed stiction releases. Candidate requires key engagement, counterholding, collar rotation, torque-limited relocking, and adjustment based on full carriage cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Record succeeds when the intact leaf reaches ≥120° and remains still for 1 s, with snapping latched as failure. Candidate requires two repeatable non-bottoming impacts within published energy, velocity, and stroke constraints plus lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both demand force awareness and avoidance of damage, but the record tests progressive breakaway by cyclic rocking; the candidate tests adjustable damping, fastening, and dynamic stop commissioning. Candidate numeric rebound, overload, collar-drift, and witness-torque criteria are missing.
